name: Minera Valparaiso S.A.
summary: Minera Valparaiso S.A., an investment company, engages in the generation and sale of electric power. It also engages in the development of forestry; and management of the real estate. The company was formerly known as Sociedad Fábrica de Cemento El Melón S.A. and changed its name to Minera Valparaíso S.A. in 1969. Minera Valparaiso S.A. was founded in 1906 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
